Social Security Office Near Me in the Bronx

'Social Security office near me' is one of the most-searched queries by Bronx residents, and the answer depends on which neighborhood you live in. The borough has six SSA field offices, each covering specific areas. This page explains which office is nearest by neighborhood and how to confirm the right one for your exact address.

The quick answer

The Bronx has six SSA field offices: South Bronx (820 Concourse Village W, 10451), East Bronx (1380 Parker St, 10462), Hunts Point (1029 E 163rd St, 10459), Laconia Avenue (3247 Laconia Ave, 10469), North Bronx (2501 Grand Concourse, 10468), and West Farms (1829 Southern Blvd, 10460). Each covers specific ZIPs. Use ssa.gov/locator with your ZIP to find your assigned office.

Which office is nearest by neighborhood

Mott Haven, Highbridge, Concourse, Melrose → South Bronx office at 820 Concourse Village West.

Hunts Point, Longwood, Foxhurst, Bronx River → Hunts Point office at 1029 East 163rd Street.

Parkchester, Castle Hill, Soundview, Westchester Square → East Bronx office at 1380 Parker Street.

West Farms, Crotona, East Tremont, Belmont, Bronxdale → West Farms office at 1829 Southern Boulevard.

Fordham, Mt Eden, Tremont, Bedford Park, University Heights, Kingsbridge Heights → North Bronx office at 2501 Grand Concourse.

Wakefield, Williamsbridge, Eastchester, Edenwald, Co-op City, Pelham Gardens → Laconia Avenue office at 3247 Laconia Avenue.

What if you live near the Bronx but not in it

Residents of nearby Westchester County (Yonkers, Mount Vernon, New Rochelle) generally have their own SSA offices closer to home. Upper Manhattan (Inwood, Washington Heights, Harlem) has its own offices and is not served by Bronx locations. Use ssa.gov/locator to confirm which office is assigned to your address.

The SSA assigns each ZIP code to a specific field office — there is no choice. You go to whichever office covers your address, regardless of which is closer to your workplace.

Tips for finding your nearest office

  • Use ssa.gov/locator with your ZIP code — official tool from the SSA.
  • Call 1-800-772-1213 to ask which office is assigned to your address.
  • Note your address's specific neighborhood (Bronx has many) to map it to one of the six offices.
  • Use the subway — parking near Bronx SSA offices is generally limited.
  • All six Bronx offices are wheelchair accessible.

Frequently asked questions

Can I visit any Bronx office or only the one for my ZIP code?
For most services, any Bronx office can help regardless of your assigned office. For some local matters tied to your record, your assigned office may need to handle it. Confirm with 1-800-772-1213 if in doubt.
What about residents of upper Manhattan?
Upper Manhattan has its own SSA offices and is not served by Bronx offices. Residents of Inwood, Washington Heights, and Harlem should check ssa.gov/locator for the right office.
How do I get to the offices without a car?
All six Bronx SSA offices are accessible by subway and bus. The South Bronx office at 820 Concourse Village West is the most-connected (B, D, 4 trains at Yankee Stadium-161st Street).
Is there parking at any office?
Street parking near Bronx SSA offices is limited and time-restricted in most areas. The Laconia Avenue office (in the more residential northern Bronx) tends to have more parking availability than the central offices. Public transit is still strongly recommended.
